plan.title: Experience capture: per model/agent/role/version tracking with recency+version weighting
plan.goal: Baseline and measure learning loops, feature activations and improvement cycles; extend agent-run-events with a dispatch->review->outcome->landing join and read it through decayed, LCB-ranked per-cell cards used for advisory routing and reports.
success_criteria: Baseline snapshot taken before activation; each feature/loop/cycle reports improved, no demonstrated change or no_baseline (J0)
Reviewer role compared across two real models with joined outcomes and reviewer_s per D5b (J1-J7)
Unknown/non-agent outcomes never change a score (learning-attribution gate, one eligibility predicate)
Efficiency metric flags concentrated contributors and shows attributed vs infrastructure failures

phases.name: Freeze
phases.goal: Frozen rev2 PRD and owner decisions 1-4

phases.name: Post-MVP
phases.goal: Wrappers, priors, rollup, alerts, exploration, routing

items.name: Freeze rev2 PRD and owner decisions
items.goal: Independent re-review of rev2 by non-author eligible lanes; owner answers decisions 1-4.
items.validation_goal: PLAN_READY recorded with lane substitutions noted.

items.name: Baseline snapshot and metric-trust checks
items.goal: aq-baseline snapshot over existing producers; concentration flag; attributed vs infrastructure split; measurement objects in tracker.json and ACTIVATION-AUDIT; pm-tracker reports no_baseline.
items.validation_goal: Reproduces 0.422 delegation success and git-archive 55.7% concentration; idempotent rerun (J0).

items.name: Capture lib, sanitizer, codex+gemini wrappers
items.goal: experience_emit over make_event; spool/flock/0600/token-redaction fixes; prompt-safe sanitizer and gitignore; model/quota fields; codex and gemini foreground+background wrappers and quota fallback emit. Depends on a dated baseline snapshot existing before merge.
items.validation_goal: Real dispatches on two lanes give complete prompt_load+model_call; secret quarantined hash-only (J1, J7).

items.name: Join review receipt, author and reviewer outcomes
items.goal: review event; D5/D5b outcomes; author_run_ids[]/reviewed_run_ids[]; redo/revert links; idempotent event_id and supersession; aq-land plumbing.
items.validation_goal: Real landing yields full chain; repeated same-head review collapses to one outcome plus waste (J2, J4).

items.name: Cards, efficiency metric, report/dashboard/QA/hints
items.goal: experience_cards.py, experience-weighting.json, one is_learning_eligible, aq-report section, dashboard route+card, aq-qa CheckResult, advisory hint, trustworthy efficiency metric. Ranking deferred (EC-P8).
items.validation_goal: Hand recomputation to 3 decimals; unknown outcome leaves S unchanged; live report (J3, J5, J6).

items.name: Wire claude, local and fanout wrappers
items.goal: Remaining delegate wrappers emit with dispatch_id==run_id.
items.validation_goal: Real dispatches on each lane give J1 chain.

items.name: Version priors and release-note intake
items.goal: Version-change detector, sourced version_priors, carry-over prior, stale-assumption flag.
items.validation_goal: Real or replayed version change yields a sourced prior-driven cell (J8).

items.name: Rollup and retention
items.goal: Daily rollup with sufficient statistics and quantile buckets, immutable cutover, verified compression of raw events over 90 days.
items.validation_goal: Rollup totals equal raw totals for a real month; size drop measured; restore test.

items.name: Divergence alerts, replay, per-instance cards
items.goal: Divergence alert job, aq-prompt-eval --replay, instance cards at n>=10.
items.validation_goal: Replay on two lanes writes comparable rows; alert or honest none.

items.name: Experiment engine with bounded exploration
items.goal: experiments.jsonl, atomic slot reservation, epsilon-greedy selector, promotion, setting_change with revert. Not started until owner decision on a non-empty eligible list (Rule 23).
items.validation_goal: Bounded experiment, gate task refused, revert verified (J9, J10).

items.name: Routing weights and automatic promotion
items.goal: Optional enforcement after 30 days of data and independent review.

items.name: Calibrated ranking
items.goal: Introduce a rank value only after an interval is calibrated for the scoring unit (distinct reviewed work item) on real data; then the advisory ranked hint.
items.validation_goal: Coverage check on real or replayed data shows nominal coverage; ranking used only if it passes.
